dishes.name: Thüringer Rostbratwurst
dishes.desc: Grilled pork sausage with a protected origin in Thuringia, seasoned with marjoram and caraway. Served in a roll with mustard.

dishes.name: Thüringer Klöße
dishes.desc: Large dumplings of raw and boiled potato, soft inside, eaten with roast or gravy. The signature Thuringian side dish.

dishes.name: Mutzbraten
dishes.desc: Pork neck marinated in onions and spices and roasted over a beechwood fire, served in a bun. A specialty of Altenburg and Thuringia.

dishes.name: Thüringer Rotwurst
dishes.desc: Coarse blood and liver sausage, traditional at Thuringian butchers and eaten on bread or with sauerkraut.

dishes.name: Weimar onion tart
dishes.desc: Yeast dough topped with onions, bacon and caraway, baked in trays. Weimar's autumn onion market made it the town's signature bake.
